definitions.gloss: beginning of the new year, start of the year
definitions.explanation: The period right after the new year begins, typically the first days or weeks of January. Commonly used to indicate timing of events or plans for early in the coming year.

examples.japanese: {年明|としあ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会|あ}いましょう→会う：00482_au⟧。
examples.english: Let's meet in the new year.

examples.japanese: {年明|としあ}け⟦{早々|そうそう}→早々：12959_sousou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Work starts right at the beginning of the new year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{年明|としあ}け⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{本格的|ほんかくてき}→本格的：05681_honkakuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦スタート→スタート：11053_sutaato⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{予定|よてい}→予定：00824_yotei⟧だ。
examples.english: The new project is scheduled to start in earnest after the new year.

notes:
USAGE:
Typically refers to early January. The expression {年明|としあ}け⟦{早々|そうそう}→早々：12959_sousou⟧ (right at the start of the new year) is very common. Often used in business and daily conversation to schedule things for early in the coming year. Contrast with ⟦{年越|としこ}し→年越し：12477_toshikoshi⟧ (seeing in the new year / New Year's Eve).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {年明|としあ}け⟦{早々|そうそう}→早々：12959_sousou⟧: right at the start of the new year
- {年明|としあ}け⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧: from the new year
- {年明|としあ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at the beginning of the new year
- {年明|としあ}け⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: after the start of the new year
